findings.summary: The extension omits the original first-login guide, completion state and replayable onboarding flow.
findings.fix: Restore a student-only guide available before lesson selection, retain completion/reset state, and update its Space instructions to the user’s new contract.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:116-117 calls showHelp for !user.onboarded; :480-506 creates the guide and saves /onboarding. Extension boot only loads settings, lectures and connections.

findings.summary: Voice and triple-Space text commands cannot be invoked from student home before selecting a lesson.
findings.fix: Make non-playback command entry available on student home; restrict only playback/seek to an active lesson. Keep the new single-Space playback contract and native text entry.
findings.evidence: Space handling requires hasLesson(); app.js:435 supplies Boolean(current). Voice/type-command triggers and command form are inside hidden #lesson. Original role-portal.js:664-674 scopes gestures by student role, not lecture selection.

findings.summary: Moving focus no longer pauses video for app guidance or external-reader access, and app focus labels are skipped while lesson speech is active.
findings.fix: Restore a generation-fenced focus playback hold: pause before app guidance, resume only after valid completion, and pause with explicit resume in reader mode; define interruption of lesson speech on navigation.
findings.evidence: Original focus-voice.js:19-35 manages pause/resume and :167-174 pauses on reader focus. Current focusin only calls announcer.say; speech.js:62 returns in reader mode or when busy, and StudentAnnouncer has no media control.

findings.summary: The “사용법” command requires a lesson and reads only command examples instead of reopening the original complete usage guide.
findings.fix: Handle help before needLesson(), expose the complete updated instructions visibly and audibly, and provide a persistent help button or manual link.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:563 handles help before lesson checks and opens showHelp; current :343-344 calls needLesson then speaks #command-help, which only contains examples and text-entry guidance.

findings.summary: A pending Space sequence survives Tab or other keyboard navigation, so playback or a voice/text action can fire after the user has moved away.
findings.fix: Cancel pending gestures when a different key, focus change or composition begins; fence delayed tap actions against their initiating context while preserving deliberate multi-tap input.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:665 cancels on non-Space keys and :674 cancels on focus change. Current reset only runs for Escape, pointerdown, blur or hidden document; Tab moves focus without cancelling gesture timers.

findings.summary: The original emergency double-Space stop during explanation or pending work is unavailable while focus is in an editor.
findings.fix: Preserve ordinary typed spaces while restoring the original stop-only double-tap path during active output, or explicitly document an approved replacement that is reachable without leaving the field.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:676-682 detects editor double taps while speech or agent work is active. Current nativeSpace excludes editors from all gesture handling, with no separate stop-only listener.

findings.summary: Cancel or Escape from text-command entry restores focus but no longer resumes the lecture that opening the dialog paused.
findings.fix: Retain the prior playback intention and restore it only on cancellation in the same lesson/account with no subsequent stop; do not resume after submitted commands or explicit stop.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:633 resumes when closeDialog(true), used by cancel/Escape at :686-689. Current openDialog calls stopAll, and its close handler only restores focus.

findings.summary: App voice no longer announces a disclosure’s changed state while its summary retains focus, and omits pressed/current state on refocus.
findings.fix: Restore focused-details toggle announcements and include meaningful aria-pressed/aria-current states in controlDescription without duplicating external-reader speech.
findings.evidence: Original focus-voice.js:61-63 describes current/pressed and :181-185 handles details toggle. Current listens only to focusin and input/select change; speech.js:79-89 has no pressed/current handling.

findings.summary: The original audible voice-ready cue is missing, leaving app-voice users without an audible signal that the three-second hold has reached recognition.
findings.fix: Provide a short nonverbal ready cue when recognition actually starts, plus an accessible status; keep the cue separate from speech captured by the recognizer.
findings.evidence: Original role-portal.js:643 invokes playSpaceVoiceReadyChime and displays a speaking overlay. Extension startVoice updates #voice-status only; StudentAnnouncer is suppressed while recognition is active.

passed: The updated user Space contract is implemented and is treated as an intentional override of the older manual’s single-Space button behavior and shorter hold timing.
Tab/Shift+Tab, standalone Shift, DOM-adjacent heading traversal, native field typing, explicit Escape exit and native dialog containment are present.
Login/field app voice, password-value exclusion, checkbox/select state descriptions, voice selection, reader mode and speech testing are present.
Panel-only event handlers and extension open/stop commands are present; lecture-host keys are not intercepted.
notes: This is an original-feature parity inspection, not a WCAG conformance result: n/a findings record missing original behavior without asserting a specific WCAG failure.
No product or test files were edited. Findings and parity notes only were written.
Static source comparison only; no fresh browser, physical keyboard, real microphone, VoiceOver or NVDA test was performed.
The existing repair test covers selected-lesson gestures and containment, not complete original-feature parity. See keyboard-parity-notes.md for evidence and test gaps.
